change.embedding_quantization: signed int8 with one graph-constant global scale and zero point
change.matrix_quantization: unchanged dynamic signed int8 per channel

evidence_boundary.sealed_parent_embedding_quantization: signed int8 per tensor, gathered before dequantization

gates: The exact known quantization-sensitive grounding probe must pass before the full screen.
All 1400 locked ABI validation prompts must pass with zero source regressions and route accuracy 1.0.
The 420-row and 43089-token native general-English preservation gate must pass.
Physical sparsity, identity, 128-byte and 1024-byte speed, bootstrap, TTFT, RSS, cache, and collapse gates remain unchanged.
rationale: Matched candidate and sealed-parent outputs have identical bytes and token counts while the per-row-scale candidate remains slower. The parent uses a single constant embedding scale, avoiding a scale Gather and per-token row multiplication.
